Job seeker can browse complete job list showing "Showing 9 jobs" with accurate count. Multiple job listings visible including newly created job at top of list. All jobs are clickable and display complete card information.

Job details page displays: title ("Senior Software Engineer - Test Position"), company ("TechCorp Solutions"), industry ("Technology"), employment type ("Full-time"), location ("San Francisco, CA"), salary range ("$100k - $150k"), posted date ("Posted Yesterday"), full description, and required skills (Python/JavaScript/AWS).

Employer can view all application details for each applicant: name ("John Smith"), email ("john.smith@example.com"), optional phone ("555-0123"), message content, and submission date ("Yesterday") displayed as distinct record under job applications.

Job seekers can filter by industry. Selected "Technology" filter reduced results from 9 to 3 jobs (only Technology jobs shown). Clicked "Clear filters" button to restore full list of 9 jobs. All results instantly updated with accurate counts.

Changing filter criteria immediately refreshes results: selecting "Technology" filter instantly updated from 9 jobs to 3 jobs. Clearing filters immediately restored 9 jobs. Result count and job list updated synchronously without page reload.

issue: Duplicate applications allowed with same email for same job
actual: System allowed second application from jane.doe@example.com for Senior Frontend Developer job. Dashboard shows both applications (Jane Doe and Jane Smith, both with jane.doe@example.com). System should prevent duplicate and keep original application unchanged.

evidence: Newly published job "Senior Software Engineer - Test Position" displays posting date as "Yesterday" which is accurate relative to current date 2026-08-24. Job card shows accurate submission date in human-readable format.

issue: Data not persisting after page reload
actual: After reloading the page, the newly created "Senior Software Engineer - Test Position" job completely disappeared. Job listings reduced from 9 to 8 jobs, and employer dashboard shows 5 active jobs instead of 6. Total applications reduced from 6 to 3. All submitted applications for the test job were lost.

evidence: Successfully deleted "Marketing Manager" job after confirmation dialog. Job removed from employer dashboard (active jobs reduced from 5 to 4). Job also removed from job seeker listing (total jobs reduced from 8 to 7). Confirmation dialog clearly stated job and its applications would be deleted.

issue: Job creation validation is insufficient - invalid data allowed
actual: System allowed job publication with: (1) No industry selected, (2) No employment type selected, (3) No location selected, (4) No required skills, (5) Invalid salary range (min $150k > max $100k). Job "Test Job" was created with "$150k - $100k" salary range. Required validations per spec: all fields required, salary must be non-negative with min <= max, at least one skill required.

issue: Job edit functionality not available or not discoverable
actual: No edit button, link, or functionality found on employer dashboard. Only view applications button and delete button are available for each job. Clicking on job title does not open edit form. No edit option found on job details page either. Employers cannot edit published job details.
